content_of_post_to_comment: I feel ashamed to start my life at 30 from scratch even my mom who passed away last year kept telling me for years to start and work hard but I just like I don't know listening and even my inner voice begged for change but I don't know why I resistance to hard work and simple things like asking for help when needed. So therefore I continue to self sabotage and felt overwhelmed.
comment: I wonder if part of the resistance comes from knowing exactly what you need to do but feeling overwhelmed by the weight of everything you've put off. That can make even asking for help feel like admitting failure. But starting at 30 isn't starting from zero; you're starting with a better understanding of what happens when you keep avoiding things. You don't have to fix your whole life at once.
